failures.detail: 庭前柏樹子 s1 o3: Wansong's Commentary on Tiantong's Book of Serenity (萬松老人評唱天童覺和尚頌古從容庵錄): Wansong Xingxiu reports a saying conventionally attributed to Zhaozhou by 州曰, then preserves Huijue's explicit denial that his former teacher ever said it. MasterName records the quoted conventional attribution, not a judgment that the attribution is historically secure.

正中偏 s1 o7: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianran of Lushan (廬山天然禪師語錄): 原頌曰 marks this as an older quoted stanza, but the line, expanded context, section heading, book title, TEI metadata, and available parallel-witness check do not securely name its historical author. Tianran Hanshi is the later quoter and author of the separate 和曰 response, not this headword-bearing original stanza.
